en.tagline: Rules that can run. Technology that can be held accountable.
en.subline: From legal research to real products.
en.heroBody: A research and engineering center at Fasilkom UI that turns legal regulation into auditable systems, and helps policymakers understand technology before they regulate it.

en.researchTitle: Four applied areas, one shared foundation.

en.disclaimer: Lexin products and research outputs are not legal advice. Use them as aids and consult a legal professional.
en.trainTitle: Helping public institutions use AI in legal work.
en.trainBody: We design research-based training and advisory programs, from AI literacy to evaluating systems in an institution’s own workflows.
en.policyTitle: We also help shape the rules.
en.policyBody: Besides turning regulation into systems, we advise policymakers who need to regulate technology. Our input rests on technical evidence: what systems can and cannot do, what the risks are, and how a rule can be enforced.
policyItems: Technical review of AI, data and digital platforms, so draft rules fit how the technology actually works.
Review of draft rules for feasibility, risk and auditability.
Assessment and testing frameworks for AI systems in institutions, from pilot to oversight.

who.title: Lexin is the Universitas Indonesia Center for Legal Informatics.
who.p1: The Universitas Indonesia Center for Legal Informatics (Lexin) is a research center at the Faculty of Computer Science, Universitas Indonesia. Lexin develops legal technology and legal informatics.
who.p2: Our research combines artificial intelligence and natural language processing with legal and product expertise. It covers legal knowledge extraction, AI for law, and legal technology platforms.

en.intro: Lexin’s research rests on a shared foundation (retrieval, reasoning, and trust and evaluation) and on infrastructure for Indonesian-language legal data. On top of it, four applied areas tackle real legal questions with partners.
en.navHint: Click a part to jump to it
en.areasTitle: From legal questions to outputs people can use.
en.foundationBody: Core research that supports all four areas. Every method is tested on Indonesian-language legal data before it is used in an applied area.

foundations.title: Retrieval & grounding
foundations.body: Finding the right articles, rulings and sources, and tying every answer back to its source.
foundations.pubTitle: LexID: The Metadata and Semantic Knowledge Graph Construction of Indonesian Legal Document
foundations.pub2Title: IRNLPUI at COLIEE 2025: Utilization of LLMs for Statute Law Retrieval and Legal Entailment Task

foundations.title: Legal reasoning
foundations.body: Modelling how norms, facts and rulings relate, including legal entailment and argumentation.
foundations.pubTitle: From Logic Programming to Machine Ethics

foundations.title: Trust & evaluation
foundations.body: Benchmarks, robustness tests and evaluation protocols so legal AI systems can be held accountable.
foundations.pubTitle: Explainable clustering: Methods, challenges, and future opportunities

open.title: Siapa saja yang kami ajak bekerja sama.
open.intro: Selain mahasiswa, peneliti, dan praktisi hukum, Lexin terbuka bekerja sama dengan:
items: Venture capital dan investor yang mendukung produk dan spin-off.
Lembaga pendanaan hibah (grants) untuk riset dan inovasi.
Lembaga negara yang menjadi mitra riset.
Direktorat di kementerian sebagai mitra riset dan uji coba.
BUMN yang ingin menguji atau memakai hasil riset.
Perusahaan yang ingin menguji, melisensikan, atau mengembangkan bersama.
Pelaku industri yang memproduktisasi riset hukum dan AI.
Kedutaan besar dan perwakilan negara sahabat.
Laboratorium dan pusat riset lain untuk kolaborasi riset.

en.intro: Four ways to get involved, depending on your role. Every collaboration starts with one conversation.

paths.body: Test our tools on real cases and help us frame the right questions.
get: Credit as a partner in related publications
ask: Time for testing sessions and interviews
Example cases or documents that can be anonymised

paths.body: Build models and evaluations on Indonesian-language legal data.
get: Access to the LexID dataset and reproducibility packages
Regular discussions with the research team

paths.body: Co-design training, studies or prototypes for your institution’s needs.
get: A team spanning law and computer science
ask: A contact person and clear goals
Access to institutional context and data where relevant

paths.body: Join the student research fellowship or write your thesis with our team.
get: A real research topic in one of the areas
ask: Interest in law, AI, or both

open.title: Who we invite to work with us.
open.intro: Beyond students, researchers and legal practitioners, Lexin is open to working with:
items: Venture capital and investors who back products and spin-offs.
Funding bodies offering grants for research and innovation.
State institutions that become research partners.
Directorates within ministries, as research and pilot partners.
State-owned enterprises that want to pilot or use research results.
Companies that want to pilot, license or co-develop.
Industry players who turn legal AI research into products.
Other laboratories and research centers for research collaboration.
